app.name: Deken
app.tagline: Desktop POS for shops and retail — sales, stock, and debts, for almost any storefront

lang.toggleAria: Switch interface language between Arabic and English

dashboard.intro: Today's snapshot from the local database: all recorded sales in your device's local day (from midnight to midnight), cash and on-account. USD amounts are approximate, using the LBP/USD rate in Settings.

summary.salesAria: Approximate US dollars: {{usd}}. Total in Lebanese pounds: {{lbp}}
summary.footnote: The summary uses the device's local time zone. Approximate US dollars = total LBP ÷ the rate in Settings. Expiry dates are not part of the catalog yet; alerts are stock-only.

alerts.emptyBody: No products are at or below the low threshold ({{threshold}}) on hand.
alerts.tableHint: Products with on-hand count at or below {{threshold}} (out of stock first, then low).

toolbar.rateLabel: Reference: 1 USD = {{rate}} LBP (from Settings, not a live market rate)

entry.title: Scan or search
entry.hint: Focus stays here for fast entry. Press Enter or tap Add to put a line on the ticket.
entry.placeholder: Type or scan the full code, then Enter…
entry.demoCodes: Only products from Products & stock. Enter the full SKU or full barcode (exact, not partial). Unknown values show an error. Quantity cannot exceed on-hand stock.
entry.exactCodeOnly: Match must be the full SKU or the full stored barcode, character-for-character (after spaces are trimmed). The Code column on the ticket shows the value you used. No partial match.

cart.title: Current ticket
cart.emptyBody: Scan or type the product’s full SKU or barcode to add the first line. This area will list items, quantities, and line totals.

summary.title: Payment
summary.payCashBlockedUnknown: Remove or replace custom lines (unknown codes) — only catalog products can be checked out.

errors.cashInsufficientStock: Not enough stock for this ticket. Lower quantities or update stock in Products.
errors.cashNotFound: A product is no longer in the catalog. Re-add lines from the catalog and try again.
errors.cashInvalid: Invalid ticket lines. Check quantities and try again.
errors.debtEmpty: Nothing to put on the account. Add products to the cart first.
errors.debtCustomerNotFound: That customer is no longer in the list. Refresh the dialog and try again.

debt.title: Record as debt
debt.subtitle: Saves the ticket as a debt sale and updates your catalog stock. Pick an existing customer, or add a new name.

fields.noDebtorMatch: No match. Try another search or add a new customer.
fields.name: Customer name
fields.hint: Type a name you’ll recognize in the debt list. You can edit details when the customer module is ready.
fields.noteHint: Stored with this debt entry when the ledger is connected.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a customer name to continue.
errors.debtorRequired: Select a debtor from the list.
errors.loadCustomers: Could not load customers. Try again, or add a new customer by name.

toast.lookupFailed: Could not look up the code: {{message}}
toast.unknownCode: No product in the catalog matches «{{code}}». Add it in Products & stock, or check spelling.
toast.addOutOfStock: «{{name}}» is out of stock. Update stock in Products or choose another item.
toast.cannotExceedStock: Only {{max}} in stock. You can’t go above that for «{{name}}».
toast.paidCashRecorded: Sale saved — {{total}}. Stock updated in the catalog.
toast.recordedDebtDetailNote: Debt saved for {{name}} — note: «{{note}}» (demo — not persisted).
toast.paidDebtRecorded: On-account sale saved: {{total}} for {{name}}. Stock was updated in the catalog.
toast.paidDebtRecordedNote: On-account sale saved: {{total}} for {{name}}. Note: «{{note}}». Stock was updated.

products.intro: The catalog is stored in the local database on this computer. Add products here; they are available in POS by SKU or barcode. Define categories in the “Product categories” tab, then assign them to products and filter the catalog.

toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, category, SKU, or barcode…

delete.title: Delete this product?
delete.confirm: Remove “{{name}}” ({{sku}}) from the catalog? This cannot be undone.

form.scannerHint: USB/Bluetooth barcode or QR readers in keyboard mode type into the focused field and often send Enter after the code. Enter goes to the next field; use Add (or Save) when you’re done — it does not auto-save on scan.
form.name: Name

errors.id_required: Product not found. Refresh the list and try again.
errors.category_not_found: That category no longer exists. Choose another or refresh the list.
errors.price_invalid: Price must be a non‑negative whole number.
errors.stock_invalid: Stock must be a non‑negative whole number.
errors.sku_taken: This SKU (or a duplicate barcode) is already in use. Choose another code.

empty.noResultsBody: Try another keyword or clear the search to see the full list.
empty.catalogEmptyBody: Add your first product to use it in POS. Search and stock updates will apply to this list.

delete.title: Delete this category?
delete.confirm: Remove “{{name}}” from the list? Products that use it must be changed first, or the delete will fail.

productCategories.emptyBody: Add categories here, then assign them on each product. Category names must be unique.

errors.id_required: Category not found. Refresh and try again.
errors.name_taken: A category with that name already exists.
errors.category_in_use: This category is used by at least one product. Change or remove the category on those products first.

debts.loadError: Could not load customer balances. Check the database, then try again.
debts.intro: Balances are: on-account sales minus payments you record here. The note under the last sale is the one saved from POS (most recent on-account sale).

toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Search by customer name or phone…

actions.recordPayNoBridgeTitle: Run inside the Deken app to record a payment.

detail.noSalesYet: No on-account sales for this customer yet.

payDialog.title: Record payment
payDialog.errorAmountRequired: Enter a valid whole number in LBP, at least 1.

errors.amount_invalid: Enter a valid amount in LBP (whole number, at least 1).
errors.payment_exceeds_balance: That amount is more than the outstanding balance. Maximum: {{max}}.
errors.no_outstanding_balance: There is nothing to pay for this customer.

empty.noSearchBody: Try another name or phone, or clear the search.
empty.noFilterBody: Change the balance filter or reset to see everyone again.
empty.noDebtorsBody: When sales on account are saved, customer rows will appear here.

mock.d1detail: Last ticket: POS debt note «corner restock» — demo only, not stored.
mock.d2detail: Balance cleared after partial cash — placeholder timeline.
mock.d3detail: Two open tickets merged in UI preview — not persisted.

reports.loadError: Could not load the sales report. Check the database, then try again.
reports.intro: Summaries and daily totals are read from sales saved on this device (cash and on-account). Pick a period or a custom from/to range, then Apply.

empty.title: No sales in this range
empty.body: There are no recorded sales between these dates. Complete a sale from POS, then run the report again or widen the range.

chart.title: Sales by day (LBP)
chart.hint: Approx. USD: {{usd}} (using the LBP/USD rate from Settings, not a live market rate).
chart.aria: Bar chart: {{n}} day columns from the database (UTC day bucket).

settings.intro: Shop-wide preferences. General settings are saved in the local database. Printing options are not wired yet.

general.lbpPerUsdHint: Used to show approximate US dollar amounts alongside Lebanese pounds (POS, debts, reports). This is a shop reference rate, not a live exchange feed.

language.note: Use the language control in the top bar to switch Arabic and English. This section will later hold regional formats.

errors.lbp_per_usd_invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 100,000,000 for LBP per dollar.
errors.lbp_invalid_client: Enter a valid whole number for the rate.
errors.shop_name_too_long: Shop name is too long (max 200 characters).

printing.receiptDisabledTitle: Printer pairing will enable this toggle.
printing.paperDisabledTitle: Paper presets will map to drivers later.
